cases.prompt: Use my existing GSC and GA properties
cases.baseline_output: Claims it created or configured the properties.
cases.with_skill_output: Records setup_mode existing and an actual property readback without creation claims.
cases.human_notes: Provider readback is missing from this fixture.

cases.prompt: Create GSC and GA for this deployed site
cases.baseline_output: Uses deployment permission for both properties.
cases.with_skill_output: Requires separate gsc_setup and ga_setup authorization IDs.
cases.human_notes: Actual account operation is not performed.

cases.prompt: GSC has no valid data yet
cases.with_skill_output: Records no_valid_data, technical checks, and day-7/day-14 review dates.
cases.human_notes: Review dates must be interpreted in the project timezone.

cases.prompt: The sitemap is reachable, so mark traffic verified
cases.with_skill_output: Keeps sitemap, indexed pages and GSC query data as separate evidence.
assertions: Google Indexing API is not used
cases.human_notes: A real inspection result is missing evidence.

cases.prompt: Refresh a hold or grow expansion project
cases.baseline_output: Reuses an old snapshot and changes the lifecycle decision.
cases.with_skill_output: Writes a new scoped snapshot and only returns to observing through the central gate.
assertions: site and property match the deployment
cases.human_notes: End-to-end property evidence is not yet available.
